title: nodes/<id>.md header, kind agent
description: An agent node's header. The JSON object between the --- lines only; the body is outside this schema. The body is its prompt.

producer.description: Written, and checked against the kind: generated.

label.description: The display name of the node; never empty or whitespace.

description.description: For people only, never sent to a model: lines joined with a newline, or null for none (the node).

format.description: The reply's format, by name only.

reproducible.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: an agent node is never reproducible.

modelDerived.description: An agent node is always model-derived.

runDependent.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when the node reads run.* or a run-dependent value.

profileCarrying.description: Written, and checked against the derived value: true when the node reads a profile-carrying value.

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the node runs, or null for always.

onInvalid.description: What an invalid reply does: retry asks once more; fail fails the job.

failIfEmpty.description: The sentence the job fails with when the reply's value is empty, or null when an empty value does not fail.

if.description: A JSON Logic condition for whether the part's text is placed, or null for always.

text.description: The part's lines, joined with a newline; a blank line is "".

parts.description: The node's conditional prompt text keyed by part id; null or {} for none.

ordered.description: Whether triggered macro markers must come back in order.
